The rtcm/centipede_*.rtcm3 excerpts are cut from public correction streams
of the Centipede-RTK network (centipede-rtk.org; caster crtk.net), captured
on 2026-10-10.

Attribution: Centipede-RTK (centipede-rtk.org), data under the Open Data
Commons Database Contents License (ODC DbCL) 1.0:
https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/dbcl/1-0/

Centipede-RTK's terms ask for this attribution and rule out redistributing
its data as a competing correction service. These files are short excerpts
(30 to 35 seconds of three stations) kept only as test inputs; they are not
a correction stream and must not be served as one.

Changes: whole frames were left out, none was edited (every kept frame keeps
its original CRC). Left out are every 1005 and 1006 (the contributors'
antenna positions) and every 1033 (their receiver serial numbers).
